a: Use semantic tags like header, nav, main, article, section, footer for structure and accessibility.
HTML5 validation uses required, type=email, min/max, pattern before submit.
aria-label provides an accessible name when visible text is missing.
aria-live regions announce dynamic updates to screen readers.
All interactive controls should be reachable and usable with the keyboard (Tab, Enter, Space).
Never remove focus outlines without a clear :focus-visible replacement.
alt text describes images for screen readers and when images fail to load.
<!DOCTYPE html> puts the browser in standards mode.
localStorage persists; sessionStorage clears when the tab closes.
script defer runs after HTML parse in order; async runs when downloaded, order not guaranteed.
